description: Satellite Flood water Extent between the Nova Kakhovka Dam Wall and the Dnipro River mouth, Khersonska Oblast, Ukraine as of 21 June 2023 is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code FL20230606UKR This map illustrates satellite-detected flood waters along the 90km downstream of Dnipro River between the damaged Nova Kakhovka Dam wall and the Dnipro River mouth in Ukraine as observed from a Sentinel-1 images acquired on 21 June 2023 at 15:36 UTC. Coverage: Ukraine. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-08-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike (CC BY-SA). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
